test_cases.name: Adding Mandatory Required Field to Existing Request Payload
test_cases.rationale: Added required billingTaxId field without default value, breaking existing clients.

test_cases.name: Removing Field from Public Response DTO
test_cases.rationale: Removed Email property from public UserResponseDto.

test_cases.name: Destructive Single-Step Database Column Drop
test_cases.rationale: Drops active column in single migration, breaking running pods during rolling deploy.

test_cases.name: Strict Deserialization Failure on Stored JSON Documents
test_cases.rationale: Configured FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true on document reader, failing on schema drift.

test_cases.name: Removing Field from Published Event Schema
test_cases.rationale: Omitted customerId from published event payload, breaking decoupled subscribers.

test_cases.name: Removing Legacy Environment Variable Fallback
test_cases.rationale: Requires DATABASE_URL without fallback to DB_HOST/DB_PORT, breaking deployments.

test_cases.name: Strict Enum Parser Crashing on Unrecognized Enum Value
test_cases.rationale: Enum.Parse throws exception on unknown incoming values from upstream services.

test_cases.name: Altering Semantic Error Status Code Breaking Client Handlers
test_cases.rationale: Altered error response from 404 to 400, breaking frontend client error routing.

test_cases.name: Missing Legacy Serialization Regression Test
test_cases.rationale: Deleted test asserting backward compatibility with previous schema representation.

test_cases.name: Backward-Compatible API and Tolerant Deserialization
test_cases.rationale: Supports both old and new parameters with fallback and ignores extra future properties.
